claim_verdicts.evidence: Cookbook: "In contrast to the default `ListView` constructor, which requires creating all items at once, the `ListView.builder()` constructor creates items as they're scrolled onto the screen." ListView API doc (Flutter 3.47.2 SDK doc comment): "constructing the [List] requires doing work for every child that could possibly be displayed in the list view instead of just those children that are actually visible." The children list is an argument expression, evaluated before the constructor call.

API doc: "the builder is called only for those children that are actually visible." Viewport doc: "The viewport has an area before and after the visible area to cache items that are about to become visible" (the 'near'). perf: "use the lazy builder methods ... only the visible portion of the screen is built". Probe, stage-3 code, 360x400, 10 000 products: 9 ProductTile on stage, 14 built in total (skipOffstage: false); 'Product 100' 0 widgets even with skipOffstage: false.
